selection_rule: Break ties with lower validation loss on the validation split.
If still tied, prefer the frozen-backbone run because it has fewer trainable parameters.

candidates.reason: Tied on validation macro F1; higher validation loss than the fine-tuned run.
Tied on validation macro F1 and had the lower validation loss.

note: Both candidates saturated the 180-image validation split. The selection therefore used validation loss as the predefined tie-breaker; the test split was not used for selection.
